  865:     private EntryQuality assessEntryQuality(TradeSignal current, BigDecimal authoritativeAtr, BigDecimal executionPrice) {
  866:         if (current == null || current.getGeneratedAt() == null || executionPrice == null
  867:                 || executionPrice.signum() <= 0) {
  868:             return new EntryQuality(0, "UNKNOWN", 0d, 0d, 0d, 0L, false, null, 0, 0d, false, null);
  869:         }
  870: 
  871:         Instant cutoff = current.getGeneratedAt().minus(EVIDENCE_WINDOW);
  872:         List<TradeSignal> recent = recentSignals(current.getSymbol(), EXECUTION_INTERVAL, current.getGeneratedAt());
  873: 
  874:         BigDecimal reference = executionPrice;
  875:         BigDecimal recentHigh = executionPrice;
  876:         Instant recentHighAt = current.getGeneratedAt();
  877:         for (TradeSignal s : recent) {
  878:             if (s.getGeneratedAt() == null || s.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(current.getGeneratedAt())) continue;
  879:             if (s.getGeneratedAt().isBefore(cutoff)) break;
  880:             if (s.getLatestPrice() != null && s.getLatestPrice().signum() > 0
  881:                     && s.getLatestPrice().compareTo(reference) < 0) {
  882:                 reference = s.getLatestPrice();
  883:             }
  884:             // FIX-091 / Fix 7: mirror the existing rolling-low memory with a rolling high.
  885:             // We intentionally use already-persisted signal prices so Replay and Production
  886:             // observe the same pre-wallet evidence and no new market-data dependency is added.
  887:             if (s.getLatestPrice() != null && s.getLatestPrice().signum() > 0
  888:                     && s.getLatestPrice().compareTo(recentHigh) > 0) {
  889:                 recentHigh = s.getLatestPrice();
  890:                 recentHighAt = s.getGeneratedAt();
  891:             }
  892:         }
  893: 
  894:         // FIX-055 + FIX-105: keep the opportunity anchor/best floor only while the opportunity
  895:         // is fresh. currentOpportunity() is Replay-aware, and age is measured exclusively from
  896:         // persisted/replayed candle-time evidence (startedAt -> signal.generatedAt), never wall-clock
  897:         // time. Therefore Production and Replay execute this exact same branch deterministically.
  898:         java.util.Optional<ExecutionOpportunity> activeOpportunity = currentOpportunity(
  899:                 current.getSymbol(), List.of("BUILDING", "WEAKENING", "BLOCKED", "CONFIRMED"));
  900:         String chaseReferenceSource = "ROLLING_30M";
  901:         if (activeOpportunity.isPresent()) {
  902:             ExecutionOpportunity opp = activeOpportunity.get();
  903:             boolean anchorStillFresh = false;
  904:             long opportunityAgeMinutesForReference = 0L;
  905: 
  906:             if (opp.getStartedAt() != null) {
  907:                 Duration opportunityAge = Duration.between(opp.getStartedAt(), current.getGeneratedAt());
  908:                 opportunityAgeMinutesForReference = Math.max(0L, opportunityAge.toMinutes());
  909:                 // FIX-105 boundary is inclusive: exactly 120 minutes keeps FIX-055 protection;
  910:                 // the first instant beyond two hours returns authority to the rolling 30m reference.
  911:                 anchorStillFresh = !opportunityAge.isNegative()
  912:                         && opportunityAge.compareTo(ANCHOR_MAX_AGE) <= 0;
  913:             }
  914: 
  915:             if (anchorStillFresh) {
  916:                 BigDecimal anchor = opp.getAnchorEntryPrice();
  917:                 BigDecimal best = opp.getBestEntryPrice();
  918:                 if (anchor != null && anchor.signum() > 0 && anchor.compareTo(reference) < 0) {
  919:                     reference = anchor;
  920:                     chaseReferenceSource = "OPPORTUNITY_ANCHOR";
  921:                 }
  922:                 if (best != null && best.signum() > 0 && best.compareTo(reference) < 0) {
  923:                     reference = best;
  924:                     chaseReferenceSource = "OPPORTUNITY_BEST";
  925:                 }
  926:             }
  927: 
  928:             // FIX-105 diagnostics are deliberately log-only in v1: no schema expansion is required
  929:             // to prove which reference won in Production or Replay. Persisted decision/opportunity
  930:             // evidence remains unchanged.
  931:             log.debug("FIX-105 chase reference symbol={} source={} reference={} opportunityAgeMinutes={} anchorFresh={}",
  932:                     current.getSymbol(), chaseReferenceSource, reference, opportunityAgeMinutesForReference, anchorStillFresh);
  933:         }
  934: 
  935:         double expansionPercent = executionPrice.subtract(reference)
  936:                 .divide(reference, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
  937:                 .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)).doubleValue();
  938: 
  939:         double atrExtension = 0d;
  940:         BigDecimal atrForExtension = authoritativeAtr != null && authoritativeAtr.signum() > 0
  941:                 ? authoritativeAtr
  942:                 : current.getAtrAtSignal();
  943:         if (atrForExtension != null && atrForExtension.signum() > 0) {
  944:             atrExtension = executionPrice.subtract(reference).max(BigDecimal.ZERO)
  945:                     .divide(atrForExtension, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP).doubleValue();
  946:         }
  947: 
  948:         long ageMinutes = activeOpportunity
  949:                 .map(o -> o.getStartedAt() == null ? 0L
  950:                         : Math.max(0L, Duration.between(o.getStartedAt(), current.getGeneratedAt()).toMinutes()))
  951:                 .orElse(0L);
  952: 
  953:         double rr = currentRewardRisk(current, executionPrice);
  954: 
  955:         // FIX-091 / Fix 7: a prior high is considered a recent rejection only when price
  956:         // subsequently backed away and the current entry is returning close to that same zone.
  957:         // v1 is deliberately conservative: this only reduces Entry Quality; it never hard-vetoes.
  958:         int rejectionCount = 0;
  959:         double distanceFromRejectedHighPercent = 0d;
  960:         BigDecimal recentRejectedHigh = null;
  961:         if (recentHigh != null && recentHigh.signum() > 0 && recentHighAt != null
  962:                 && recentHighAt.isBefore(current.getGeneratedAt())) {
  963:             for (TradeSignal s : recent) {
  964:                 if (s.getGeneratedAt() == null || !s.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(recentHighAt)
  965:                         || s.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(current.getGeneratedAt()) || s.getLatestPrice() == null) continue;
  966:                 if (s.getLatestPrice().compareTo(recentHigh) < 0) rejectionCount++;
  967:             }
  968:             distanceFromRejectedHighPercent = recentHigh.subtract(executionPrice).abs()
  969:                     .divide(recentHigh, 8, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
  970:                     .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)).doubleValue();
  971:             if (rejectionCount >= 2 && distanceFromRejectedHighPercent <= 0.50d) {
  972:                 recentRejectedHigh = recentHigh;
  973:             }
  974:         }
  975: 
  976:         int score = 100;
  977: 
  978:         if (expansionPercent > 8d) score -= 50;
  979:         else if (expansionPercent > 5d) score -= 35;
  980:         else if (expansionPercent > 3d) score -= 22;
  981:         else if (expansionPercent > 1.5d) score -= 10;
  982: 
  983:         if (atrExtension > 6d) score -= 30;
  984:         else if (atrExtension > 4d) score -= 20;
  985:         else if (atrExtension > 2.5d) score -= 10;
  986: 
  987:         if (ageMinutes > 60) score -= 15;
  988:         else if (ageMinutes > 40) score -= 10;
  989:         else if (ageMinutes > 20) score -= 5;
  990: 
  991:         if (rr <= 0d || rr < 1d) score -= 30;
  992:         else if (rr < 1.25d) score -= 15;
  993:         else if (rr >= 2d) score += 5;
  994: 
  995:         if (recentRejectedHigh != null) {
  996:             // FIX-091 / Fix 7 v1 is penalty/size-reduction only. A rejection penalty must not
  997:             // by itself push an otherwise non-chase entry below the hard CHASE_ENTRY cutoff.
  998:             int beforeRejectionPenalty = score;
  999:             score -= RECENT_REJECTION_ENTRY_QUALITY_PENALTY;
 1000:             if (beforeRejectionPenalty >= CHASE_ENTRY_CUTOFF) {
 1001:                 score = Math.max(CHASE_ENTRY_CUTOFF, score);
 1002:             }
 1003:         }
 1004: 
 1005:         if ("HIGH_VOLATILITY".equals(String.valueOf(current.getMarketRegime()))) score -= 10;
 1006: 
 1007:         // FIX-055: STOP_EXPOSED remains a soft warning (TARGET_BLOCKED is still the
 1008:         // hard liquidity veto), but an exposed stop must reduce entry quality and
 1009:         // therefore position size or block a chase through the existing quality guard.
 1010:         if (current.getLiquidityStatus() == LiquidityContextStatus.STOP_EXPOSED) {
 1011:             score -= STOP_EXPOSED_ENTRY_QUALITY_PENALTY;
 1012:         }
 1013: 
 1014:         if ("BREAKOUT".equals(String.valueOf(current.getMarketRegime()))
 1015:                 && expansionPercent <= 3d && atrExtension <= 2.5d) score += 5;
 1016: 
 1017:         score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
 1018:         String classification = score >= 85 ? "EXCELLENT_ENTRY"
 1019:                 : score >= 70 ? "GOOD_ENTRY"
 1020:                 : score >= 55 ? "ACCEPTABLE_ENTRY"
 1021:                 : score >= CHASE_ENTRY_CUTOFF ? "LATE_ENTRY"
 1022:                 : "CHASE_ENTRY";
 1023: 
 1024:         boolean moderateBtcConflict = current.getBtcContextStatus() == com.crypto.domain.BtcContextStatus.CONFLICT;
 1025:         boolean transitionProbe = "TRANSITION_PROBE".equals(current.getEntryAuthority());
 1026:         Integer authorityCap = current.getEntryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent();
 1027:         return new EntryQuality(score, classification, expansionPercent, atrExtension, rr, ageMinutes,
 1028:                 moderateBtcConflict, recentRejectedHigh, rejectionCount, distanceFromRejectedHighPercent,
 1029:                 transitionProbe, authorityCap);
 1030:     }

 1171:     private ExecutionDecision applyInitialEntryQualityGuard(ExecutionDecision decision, EntryQuality q) {
 1172:         if (decision == null || !decision.allowed()) return decision;
 1173:         if (q.score() < CHASE_ENTRY_CUTOFF) {
 1174:             return ExecutionDecision.building(
 1175:                     "CHASE_ENTRY_BLOCKED",
 1176:                     "The market signal is valid, but Entry Quality is only " + q.score()
 1177:                             + "/100 (" + q.classification() + "). Price has already expanded "
 1178:                             + format(q.expansionPercent()) + "% from the recent opportunity base and "
 1179:                             + format(q.atrExtension()) + " ATR. The engine will not buy a late-stage chase.",
 1180:                     decision.evidence());
 1181:         }
 1182: 
 1183:         int cap = q.score() >= 85 ? 50 : q.score() >= 70 ? 40 : 25;
 1184:         StringBuilder capReason = new StringBuilder(" Entry Quality ")
 1185:                 .append(q.score()).append("/100 (").append(q.classification()).append(")");
 1186: 
 1187:         // FIX-091 / Fix 1: moderate BTC conflict stays fast and BUY-eligible, but may not
 1188:         // receive full exposure. Classification remains owned by BtcMarketContextService.
 1189:         if (q.moderateBtcConflict()) {
 1190:             int btcConflictCap = q.score() >= 85 ? BTC_MODERATE_CONFLICT_EXCELLENT_CAP
 1191:                     : q.score() >= 70 ? BTC_MODERATE_CONFLICT_GOOD_CAP
 1192:                     : BTC_MODERATE_CONFLICT_LATE_CAP;
 1193:             cap = Math.min(cap, btcConflictCap);
 1194:             capReason.append("; BTC context is CONFLICT, so the same tiered initial-entry model reduces exposure to ")
 1195:                     .append(btcConflictCap).append("%");
 1196:         }
 1197:         // FIX-091 / Fix 5: EntryAuthority is only a maximum size. The current signal has already
 1198:         // travelled through the normal direct-candidate + validateBuy flow before this guard runs.
 1199:         // The EntryQuality snapshot is created from the current TradeSignal, so the explicit cap is
 1200:         // carried through the signal fields without inventing a parallel execution route.
 1201:         if (q.entryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent() != null && q.entryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent() > 0) {
 1202:             cap = Math.min(cap, q.entryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent());
 1203:             if (q.transitionProbe()) {
 1204:                 capReason.append("; BREAKOUT_TRANSITION probe authority caps exposure at ")
 1205:                         .append(q.entryAuthorityMaxPositionPercent()).append("%");
 1206:             }
 1207:         }
 1208:         if (q.recentRejectedHigh() != null) {
 1209:             capReason.append("; recent rejection zone near ").append(q.recentRejectedHigh())
 1210:                     .append(" reduced entry quality without creating a hard veto");
 1211:         }
 1212: 
 1213:         int reduced = Math.min(decision.positionPercent(), cap);
 1214:         if (reduced == decision.positionPercent()) return decision;
 1215: 
 1216:         return ExecutionDecision.allow(
 1217:                 decision.source(),
 1218:                 decision.code(),
 1219:                 reduced,
 1220:                 decision.explanation() + capReason + " capped the initial allocation at " + reduced
 1221:                         + "% so confirmation can add later instead of committing full size at once.",
 1222:                 decision.evidence());
 1223:     }

 2364:         }

 2366:         int momentum = 0;
 2367:         for (int i = 1; i < sequence.size(); i++) {

package com.crypto.repository;

import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface TradeSignalRepository extends JpaRepository<TradeSignal, Long> {
    boolean existsBySymbolAndIntervalAndCandleOpenTime(
            String symbol, String interval, Instant candleOpenTime
    );

    Optional<TradeSignal> findBySymbolAndIntervalAndCandleOpenTime(
            String symbol, String interval, Instant candleOpenTime
    );

    Optional<TradeSignal> findTopBySymbolOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(String symbol);
    Optional<TradeSignal> findTopBySymbolAndIntervalOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(String symbol, String interval);
    Optional<TradeSignal> findTopBySymbolAndIntervalAndGeneratedAtLessThanEqualOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(
            String symbol, String interval, Instant generatedAt
    );
    Optional<TradeSignal> findTopBySymbolAndIntervalAndGeneratedAtLessThanOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(
            String symbol, String interval, Instant generatedAt
    );

    // FIX-141: selection by candle close time, not generatedAt. generatedAt-only ordering let a
    // backfilled/reprocessed signal for an OLD candle (stamped with a recent generatedAt) outrank
    // a legitimately newer candle's signal whose generatedAt was earlier. candleOpenTime is the
    // caller's look-ahead bound (evaluationTime minus the interval duration, i.e. the latest candle
    // open time whose close has already happened); generatedAt still may not exceed evaluationTime
    // either, so a signal can't be picked before it was actually generated.
    Optional<TradeSignal> findTopBySymbolAndIntervalAndCandleOpenTimeLessThanEqualAndGeneratedAtLessThanEqualOrderByCandleOpenTimeDesc(
            String symbol, String interval, Instant candleOpenTime, Instant generatedAt
    );
    List<TradeSignal> findTop100ByOrderByGeneratedAtDesc();
    List<TradeSignal> findTop20BySymbolOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(String symbol);
    List<TradeSignal> findTop20BySymbolAndIntervalOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(String symbol, String interval);

    List<TradeSignal> findBySymbolAndIntervalAndDecisionInAndGeneratedAtGreaterThanEqualOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(
            String symbol, String interval, List<SignalDecision> decisions, Instant generatedAt, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable
    );

    List<TradeSignal> findBySymbolAndIntervalAndDecisionInOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(
            String symbol, String interval, List<SignalDecision> decisions, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable
    );
    List<TradeSignal> findByGeneratedAtGreaterThanEqualOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(Instant generatedAt);

    // FIX-116A: Score Diagnostics needs scalar score/decision fields only. Do not load the wide
    // TradeSignal entity (JSON/TEXT context, explanations, snapshots) for this dashboard read.
    @Query("""
            select s.symbol as symbol, s.interval as interval, s.totalScore as totalScore,
                   s.rawScore as rawScore, s.maximumAvailableScore as maximumAvailableScore,
                   s.trendScore as trendScore, s.volumeScore as volumeScore,
                   s.momentumScore as momentumScore, s.sentimentScore as sentimentScore,
                   s.fundamentalScore as fundamentalScore, s.originalDecision as originalDecision,
                   s.decision as decision, s.selectedStrategy as selectedStrategy
            from TradeSignal s
            where s.generatedAt >= :from
            order by s.generatedAt desc
            """)
    List<TradeSignalDiagnosticsProjection> findScoreDiagnosticsSince(@Param("from") Instant from);
    long countByGeneratedAtGreaterThanEqual(Instant generatedAt);

    @Query("""
            select count(distinct s.symbol) from TradeSignal s
            where s.generatedAt >= :from
            """)
    long countDistinctSymbolsSince(@Param("from") Instant from);

    @Query("select count(distinct s.symbol) from TradeSignal s")

    long countBuyCandidatesSince(
            @Param("from") Instant from,
            @Param("buy") SignalDecision buy,
            @Param("strongBuy") SignalDecision strongBuy);

    // FIX-039: Blocked-signal diagnostics are filtered in the database by symbol and time
    // so a narrow symbol/date search cannot be lost behind a generic recent-row limit.
    @Query("""
            select s from TradeSignal s
            where s.finalEntryAllowed = false
              and (s.decision in (:buy, :strongBuy)
                   or s.originalDecision in (:buy, :strongBuy))
              and (:symbol is null or upper(s.symbol) = :symbol)
              and s.generatedAt between :from and :to
            order by s.generatedAt desc
            """)
    List<TradeSignal> findBlockedBuys(
            @Param("buy") SignalDecision buy,
            @Param("strongBuy") SignalDecision strongBuy,
            @Param("symbol") String symbol,
            @Param("from") Instant from,
            @Param("to") Instant to,
            org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable);

    // FIX-143: Read-only visibility for allowed BUY signals with no executed wallet BUY.
    // Match by immutable signal identity, not nearby symbol/time or an unrelated position.
    // Apply all predicates before pagination so executed rows cannot hide unexecuted signals.
    @Query("""
            select s from TradeSignal s
            where s.finalEntryAllowed = true
              and s.decision in (:buy, :strongBuy)
              and (:symbol is null or s.symbol = :symbol)
              and s.generatedAt between :from and :to
              and not exists (
                  select wt.id from WalletTrade wt
                  where wt.signal.id = s.id
                    and wt.side = 'BUY' and wt.status = 'EXECUTED'
              )
            order by s.generatedAt desc, s.id desc
            """)
    List<TradeSignal> findAllowedUnexecutedBuys(
            @Param("buy") SignalDecision buy,
            @Param("strongBuy") SignalDecision strongBuy,
            @Param("symbol") String symbol,
            @Param("from") Instant from,
            @Param("to") Instant to,
            org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable);

    // A blocked SELL means the isolated/base SELL or STRONG_SELL candidate was persisted,
    // but the final decision pipeline changed it to a non-SELL state. This is audit-only.
    @Query("""
            select s from TradeSignal s

              and s.generatedAt between :from and :to

            """)
    List<TradeSignal> findBlockedSells(

    List<TradeSignal> findBySymbolAndCandleOpenTimeBetweenOrderByCandleOpenTimeAsc(

    );
    // FIX-100: Trade Inspector signal analysis reads the persisted signal ledger directly.
    // Filtering by symbol/time happens in SQL so the diagnostic grid can inspect a real

    @Query("""

            order by s.generatedAt desc

    // not wallet history, so symbols that never executed are still analyzable.

    List<String> findDistinctInspectorSymbols();

package com.crypto.wallet.domain;

import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
import com.crypto.position.domain.PositionAnalysis;
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.*;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;

@Entity
@Table(name = "wallet_trade")
@Getter @Setter @Builder @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor
public class WalletTrade {
    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;
    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "signal_id")
    private TradeSignal signal;
    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "position_analysis_id")
    private PositionAnalysis positionAnalysis;
    @Column(name = "execution_key", length = 100)
    private String executionKey;
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 30)
    private String symbol;
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 10)
    private String side;
    @Column(nullable = false, precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal quantity;
    @Column(name = "price_usdt", nullable = false, precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal priceUsdt;
    /** FIX-056 immutable signal-time price used for decision audit only. */
    @Column(name = "decision_price_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal decisionPriceUsdt;
    /** FIX-056 UTC timestamp of the canonical market event used as the fill authority. */
    @Column(name = "execution_price_observed_at")
    private Instant executionPriceObservedAt;
    @Column(name = "gross_amount_usdt", nullable = false, precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal grossAmountUsdt;
    @Column(name = "fee_usdt", nullable = false, precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal feeUsdt;
    @Column(name = "net_amount_usdt", nullable = false, precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal netAmountUsdt;
    @Column(name = "cost_basis_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal costBasisUsdt;
    @Column(name = "realized_pnl_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal realizedPnlUsdt;
    @Column(name = "realized_pnl_percent", precision = 20, scale = 8)
    private BigDecimal realizedPnlPercent;
    @Column(name = "execution_type", nullable = false, length = 20)
    private String executionType;
    @Column(name = "execution_reason", length = 40)
    private String executionReason;
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 20)
    private String status;
    @Column(name = "executed_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant executedAt;
    @Column(length = 500)
    private String notes;
    // FIX-126: complete execution explanations must not abort wallet persistence.
    @Column(name = "execution_message", columnDefinition = "MEDIUMTEXT")
    private String executionMessage;
}

## FINDINGS — Iteration 5: Entry Quality

### PROJECT EVIDENCE

- The frozen cohort remains exactly: **182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137**. No substitution or numeric-log correlation was used.

- Entry quality for every frozen trade is currently **UNVERIFIABLE**, not “weak” or “supported.” The permitted `db/CODEX/` directory has no schema or result evidence, so none of the six `paper_position` rows can be linked to its entry signal, wallet fill, managed position, or opportunity evidence.

- Current source’s entry-quality model is independent of signal quality. It scores the actual execution-time price against a rolling 30-minute reference/opportunity anchor, ATR extension, current reward/risk, opportunity age, recent-rejection zone, volatility, and stop-exposure status. It blocks scores below 50 as `CHASE_ENTRY`; 50–54 are `LATE_ENTRY`; 55–69 are acceptable; 70–84 good; 85+ excellent. [ExecutionIntelligenceService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/service/ExecutionIntelligenceService.java:844) [ExecutionIntelligenceService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/service/ExecutionIntelligenceService.java:976)

- The current normal BUY path resolves a fresh canonical execution price after signal/HTF gates, rejects a fill at/below stop or at/above target, then re-scores entry quality at that execution price before wallet execution. [PaperTradingService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:340) [ExecutionIntelligenceService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/service/ExecutionIntelligenceService.java:1150)

- Current source persists the entry signal reference on `paper_position`; it persists the decision-time price, execution-time price, and observation time on `wallet_trade`. [PaperPosition.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/domain/PaperPosition.java:45) [WalletTrade.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/wallet/domain/WalletTrade.java:28)

- Current source records `entry_quality_score` and stage on `wallet_managed_position`, but a later scale-in overwrites both fields. Therefore a closed managed-position row is not, by itself, durable proof of the original entry’s quality or route. [WalletAutoExecutionService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/wallet/service/WalletAutoExecutionService.java:129) [WalletManagedPosition.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/wallet/domain/WalletManagedPosition.java:56)

- A `paper_position.signal` alone may not fully explain the entry route: a 5m setup-wakeup can provide contextual authority while the latest eligible 1m signal remains the execution/risk plan. This must be reconstructed from contemporaneous rows, not inferred from the loss outcome. [PaperTradingService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:292)
